bayts.text: Yours my eulogy, O possessor of righteousness, O possessor of success, O possessor of abundance.
In you I call all the lands to the Lord of the servants, He (Allah) who raised the canopy of heaven.
In you I have erased what I had committed; in you I have sought the most fruitful increase.
In you my going, in you my returning, without estrangement: to you is my belonging.
You have removed my fault, surrounded my person with care, without sorrow and without vanity.
O best of effacers (Al-Māḥī), who erased my fault, together with the jesting of the days of youth.
You are my Beloved, O you whose love is within me, without faults and without bondage.
O best of those who heed, O best of shepherds, O best of those who call to the Lord of heaven!
May (God) send blessing upon you, together with those who are with you, and praise you in the hour of battle.
May He (Allah) who through you exalted the people of the turban pour upon you unceasingly peace and honour.
Through you I guide, through you I bring benefit, O you who surpass those who have been chosen,
(over) the people of intellect, on the path of the Messenger, effacer of heedlessness, effacer of concealment,
(over) the people of discernment, by him who possesses splendour, effacer of error, effacer of harshness.
He (Muḥammad) is the Obeyed, he is the Valiant: through him those who refuse are struck with awe.
He is the Friend (of God), he is the Confidant, he is the Pure Chosen One (Aṣ-Ṣafī), possessor of election.
He is the Noble in rank, he is the Noble in lineage, he is the Wondrous, manifest in his gifts.
He is the Precious: do not compare him (to anyone)! He is the Chief of the Prophets.
Sun of suns, head of heads, the best of intimate companions for the Saints.
Healing of hearts, light of the dwellings, full moon of full moons, manifest in his radiance.
Beneficent rain for the grateful, a lion to the ungrateful, repeller of the averse, showing aversion (to evil).
Gardens (of Paradise) for the guided, fires for the transgressor: his excellence is manifest to the wise.
He erases sins, makes gifts manifest, guides the creatures, without excess.
His is excellence, his the Intercession (ash-shafāʿa), his the Community; he encompasses every ascent.
If one, seeking to meet him, desires knowledge, or desires gain, or desires wrongdoing,
the first is guided, the second receives his gifts, and the third is cast to ruin, in wretchedness.
Guide and protector, illuminating light, rain bearing glad tidings, for whoever accepts guidance.
Defender and helper, far-sighted caller, a warning lion, for whoever transgresses.
He heeds the complaint of the complainer, he is joy for the weeping, he lends his ear to whoever speaks and whoever calls.
Saviour of the wayfarer on the Path, refuge of the ascetic, dispeller of darkness from the God-fearing.
Spoil of the poor, mender of the broken, renown of the lowly, for whoever seeks protection.
He (Muḥammad) is the Manifest, he is the Hidden, he is the intimate Confidant of Him (Allah) who possesses Permanence.
To him the (divine) Word is addressed, his is the answer, his the rightness, together with good pleasure.
His is piety, his is joy: the Houris (of Paradise) receive him after the Decree is fulfilled.
To him my words are addressed, after my repentance from every fault, with firm resolve.
Yours (O Prophet) are wonders, from the Lord of creatures, that belonged to no predecessor and will belong to no successor.
Among them, the turning away of every loathsome thing from whoever fears, after he has sought refuge (with you).
O best of creatures, you have driven calamities away from the one laden with sins: you have willed my salvation.
You are the Generous, I am the Servant (Khadīm): forever I shall make my praise of you endure.
I have sought a eulogy that grants success, that suffices against disgrace and hardship.
Truly, through my eulogy I have beheld my gain with certainty, and my success together with the edifice (I raise).
But I have fallen short of what I sought, and I have not praised (as I would wish), like the noble ones.
My ink has run dry, my heart has been left bewildered in praising the Guide of the Substitutes (al-Abdāl).
How then could I encompass the praise of him (Muḥammad) who gives life (to hearts), when his praise exhausts even the wise?
But I call all the servants to my pillar (Muḥammad), with none sent away.
O people of the land, O people of the sea, turn towards the Kind One, ocean of generosity!
He erases my faults, unveils the mysteries hidden from me, cleanses my inmost being of darkness.
He bestows benefits, fells my enemies, grants what I desire, in ease.
He erases vices, grants virtues, revives dwellings after they have been effaced.
How excellent a Beloved! How excellent a Near One! How excellent a Wise One, effacer of what is hidden!
He protected the family, spared the fighting, erased the arena (of strife), without reconciliation.
He has hidden evils, made good things manifest, led joy to whoever hopes.
He has healed the sick, banished pain, led the Servant (Khadīm) to salvation.
He has loosed the fetters, spread grace: harm has turned its back, and benefit has come.
He dispels misfortunes, manifests wonders, banishes calamities, he is manifest in his gifts.
He bestows good things even upon the palaces, he is manifest in victories, he is manifest in splendour.
